newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were little changed on Thursday, supported by steady nearby demand, several dealers said.
Feed demand has improved this week from last week, a St. Louis dealer said.
He noted some pastures were deteriorating in Oklahoma and Missouri, increasing demand for wheat middlings.
In the Northeast, demand was steady underpinned by recent reduction in flour mill runtimes, a Buffalo dealer said.
"We do have some extra (flour mill) runtime coming this weekend," the dealer said, which may have trimmed prices for next week by $1 or $2.
In the southeast, millfeed activity was subdued, a North Carolina dealer said.
He pointed out feedmixers were using cheaper substitutes like gluten feed, soyhulls and hominy in their ingredients.
Interest in deferred positions has slackened following the recent runup of Chicago Board of Trade corn futures, he said.
